      description: The Planner repeatedly issues nearly identical instructions to WebSurfer without incorporating new search angles or sources after multiple failures to find a definitive date, causing redundant searches.

      description: WebSurfer may fail to extract the specific date from the visible snippets or misreport the content of the search results due to parsing errors.
      severity: 0.70

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner may base its next decision on false premises, such as believing the date is unknown when it is actually present in the results.
    - type: loop_issue
      description: If WebSurfer consistently returns the same unhelpful results without varying the search strategy or noting the presence of the date in snippets, it reinforces a loop of "search -> no date found -> search again."
      severity: 0.65

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner continues to direct WebSurfer into the same unproductive search pattern.
